note: Tolerable upper intake levels (UL) for adults, the daily amount checked in code before a supplement suggestion is shown (agent/supplements.js). From the NIH Office of Dietary Supplements fact sheets (Health Professional versions), which cite the Food and Nutrition Board. limits: the UL in one or more units (each is the same amount); ages: an inclusive age band, the first matching band wins and a band without ages applies to every adult. A supplement not listed here is not checked in code; the suggestion's precautions must state its upper limit or say none is established. No personal data.
